summary: Kean's AIPAC endorsement, his recorded yes vote on the $14.3B Israel Security Supplemental containing no Palestinian humanitarian aid, and his Yea on H.R. 6090 incorporating the IHRA definition into education-discrimination enforcement mark him as a strong defender of Israel. His 2025 statements framing the conflict around October 7 and calling the Israel-Hamas agreement a historic peace deal reinforce that Israel-centric posture. 314 Action Fund, a PAC that received UDP funding, spent approximately $210K against him in 2024.
